2607.00063.title: Spectral Geometry and Bosonic-Bloch Probes: Explorations in Quantum Learning
2607.00063.paper_summary: This paper studies how spectral geometry emerges in quantum learning models and how it can be diagnosed with physically grounded probes. In graph-regularized quantum networks, training reorganizes the output similarity graph, increases the effective spectral dimension Delta S = +0.23, and reshapes the Laplacian spectrum. Edge-resolved two-boson interference directly probes this restructuring: the bosonic enhancement Delta P_uv correlates with the Fiedler edge split |Delta v_2| (r = -0.50), linking learned spectral partitions to interference signatures. A phase diagram shows a nonmonotonic dependence of performance on coupling strength gamma and noise delta, with graph regularization improving fidelity only in a restricted regime; hardware experiments confirm the predicted interference behavior within shot-noise uncertainty. We also analyze a hybrid quantum autoencoder and introduce Bloch-space drift as a geometric diagnostic of its latent representation. With an unsupervised benign-data threshold, the model achieves high ranking performance (ROC-AUC about 0.99) and negligible false-negative rates. Absolute Bloch drift strongly discriminates anomalies (ROC-AUC at least about 0.9), while consecutive drift is near random (ROC-AUC about 0.5), showing that detection arises from persistent state-space displacement rather than local fluctuations. Through the geometry of reduced single-qubit states and associated quantum Fisher information, these results show that learning-induced spectral organization appears as measurable quantum-state structure, establishing a unified spectral-geometric framework for diagnosing quantum learning systems with bosonic and Bloch probes.
2607.00063.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文研究了光譜幾何如何在量子學習模型中出現，以及如何使用物理基礎的探針進行診斷。在圖形正則化的量子網絡中，訓練重新組織了輸出相似性圖，增加了有效的光譜維度 Delta S = +0.23，並重塑了拉普拉斯光譜。邊緣解析的雙玻色子干涉直接探測這一重組：玻色增強 Delta P_uv 與 Fiedler 邊緣分裂 |Delta v_2| 相關（r = -0.50），將學習到的光譜劃分與干涉特徵聯繫起來。相圖顯示性能對耦合強度 gamma 和噪聲 delta 的非單調依賴，圖形正則化僅在有限的範圍內提高了保真度；硬體實驗確認了在拍攝噪聲不確定性範圍內預測的干涉行為。我們還分析了一個混合量子自編碼器，並將 Bloch 空間漂移引入作為其潛在表示的幾何診斷。通過無監督的良性數據閾值，該模型實現了高排名性能（ROC-AUC 約 0.99）和可忽略的假陰性率。絕對 Bloch 漂移強烈區分異常（ROC-AUC 至少約 0.9），而連續漂移則接近隨機（ROC-AUC 約 0.5），顯示檢測來自持續的狀態空間位移而非局部波動。通過降低的單量子位狀態的幾何和相關的量子費舍爾信息，這些結果顯示學習引起的光譜組織表現為可測量的量子態結構，建立了一個統一的光譜幾何框架，用於用玻色子和 Bloch 探針診斷量子學習系統。
